app.title: VPN Pulse
app.showcase: Showcase controls — not part of the app
status.noRecommendation: No server with a confirmed check yet
status.hint: Tap a server to see its details
status.settingUpBody: The administrator is connecting servers. The first data will appear here as soon as it arrives.
status.offlineBody: Showing the last data from {time}. It may be outdated.
source.pc.full: Full VPN check from a computer in Russia
source.mobile.full: Mobile network in Russia outside the VPN; the tunnel is not tested
source.abroad.full: Check from another server, from abroad
source.detail.handshakeHttps: handshake and HTTPS through the tunnel
server.chartSummary: Connections over {range}. The bar under the chart shows state: green — working, amber — issues, red — check failed, gap — no data.
server.conflict: Sources disagree: {a}, but {b}. Showing a cautious state.
server.stale: Data is stale: last evidence {duration} ago
events.title: Events
events.emptyBody: Monitoring has been running since {date}. A record will appear here as soon as a state changes.
keys.title: VPN profiles
keys.mvp: New profiles are currently issued by the administrator
keys.body: Message them — you will get a file or a QR code personally. It takes a couple of minutes.
keys.reserve: If you have a backup profile, select it in Amnezia
keys.reserveBody: It uses the same key with a different address. Keep it imported and switched off.
help.title: Help
help.step1.title: Check the status
help.step1.body: If the server ring is green, the problem is on your side: network, app or profile.
help.step2.title: Reconnect
help.step2.body: Turn the VPN off and on. The client will look up the server address again.
help.step3.title: Switch server
help.step3.body: Pick the server marked “Recommended” — its check has passed.
help.step4.title: Enable the backup profile
help.step4.body: If you have one, select it in Amnezia. If not, contact the administrator.
help.whyIncident: The server is alive and reachable from abroad, but checks from Russia fail while regular internet works. Usually this means the address is blocked. The administrator requests a new one; profiles do not change.
help.whyOk: All checks pass. If it does not work for you, the cause is on your device or in your network.
help.whyUnknown: There are no recent checks: the probes are not reporting. The server may be working — we just cannot confirm it right now.
admin.title: Administrator
admin.note.empty: No note. It will appear above the server list for all members.
admin.note.placeholder: What is happening and what members should do
admin.note.deleteConfirm: Delete the note? Members will stop seeing it.
admin.enroll.title: Enrollment code
admin.enroll.body: Enter the code in the app within 10 minutes. It is single-use and is not a permanent token.
admin.revokeConfirm: Revoke access for “{name}”? It will stop sending reports.
admin.demoAction: Demo action: nothing changes in the mockup
admin.serverAddBody: Run the command where VPN Pulse is installed. The wizard asks for the server type, a name and SSH access.
admin.diag.blocked: Blocked in Russia: two timeouts in a row from Russia, reachable from abroad, SSH responds.
admin.diag.action: Ask the host for a new address. DDNS will pick it up; member profiles do not change.
android.title: VPN Pulse Probe
android.subtitle: Mobile-network check from Russia
android.bind.title: Enroll this phone
android.bind.body: Enter the code from the Admin section of the Mini App. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
android.bind.error: The code did not match or has expired. Request a new one.
android.exclude: Exclude VPN Pulse Probe in Split App Tunneling
android.exclude.body: Open Amnezia → Split App Tunneling → add VPN Pulse Probe to the apps that work without VPN. Then reconnect Amnezia.
android.exclude.why: Otherwise the checks go through the tunnel and show reachability from abroad, not from Russia.
android.cellularReady: Checks use the mobile network outside the VPN
android.cellular.checking: Checking the path through the mobile network…
android.cellular.ok: Path confirmed: requests go through the mobile network, bypassing the VPN
android.cellular.fail: Requests still go through the VPN or Wi-Fi
android.cellular.fix: Check the exclusion in Amnezia and turn on mobile data
android.pcChecksVpn: VPN tunnels are checked by the computer
android.done.body: This phone will check the mobile network from Russia. Tap “Start” whenever convenient.
android.main.everyMinute: every minute while the screen is on
android.main.background: in background — at most every 15 minutes
android.offline: Offline — results are saved and will be sent later
android.stale: No checks for a long time
android.wifiOn: Wi-Fi and Amnezia are on — not interfering
error.authBody: Open the app from the chat where the bot was added. Code: {code}
onboarding.title: VPN Pulse first run
onboarding.intro: This is what the app looks like right after installing it from the open repository — before any servers or probes are connected.
onboarding.demoBody: install.sh demo starts the interface on fictional data. The “Demo data” label is always visible.
onboarding.cleanBody: No servers yet. A member sees a calm “being set up”; the administrator sees one command.
onboarding.partialBody: A server is connected but there are no probes. The system shows incomplete coverage, not a green success.
onboarding.doctorBody: vpn-pulse doctor checks the whole chain and gives one next step for every warning.
server.checksNone: No probes connected — the state is confirmed by member connections
doctor.probes.silent: Wake the computer or check its network; the probe resumes on its own
doctor.probes.afterServer: After the server, enroll the probes
doctor.collector.fail: The collector has not run yet — start the vpn-pulse service
doctor.collector.stale: The collector has not reported for a while — check the service and server access
doctor.queue.stuck: Notifications are stuck ({n} queued) — check the bot
doctor.storage.missing: The database does not exist yet — run vpn-pulse init
doctor.storage.broken: The database cannot be opened — check the path and file permissions
doctor.telegram.missing: Telegram is not configured — messages are printed to the console; add the telegram block to config.yaml
doctor.telegram.tokenMissing: The bot token file is missing or empty — create it with 0600 permissions
doctor.telegram.permissions: The bot token file is readable by other users — run chmod 600
attention.probesNotEnrolled: Probes are not enrolled: server state is confirmed only by member connections.
attention.probeSilent: The {name} probe has been silent for {duration}.
attention.collectorStale: The collector is not reporting — server data is going stale.
bot.unavailable: 🔴 {server}: connections fail — the check confirmed an outage
bot.start: See whether the VPN servers work right now and which one to pick. Tap the button — the app opens inside Telegram.
attention.KERNEL_MODULE_MISMATCH: Kernel updated; the VPN module is built only for the current kernel. A reboot would leave the server without VPN.
attention.ENGINE_UNREADABLE: The collector could not read the VPN interface: check the helper (sudo, interface or container name).
attention.DISK_PRESSURE: Disk {disk}%, swap {swap}%. There is something to free.
attention.DDNS_MISMATCH: The server's domain does not point at its current address — check DDNS.
attention.TUNING_LOST: Network tuning lost: congestion control is {cc} instead of bbr.
doctor.collectors.none: No server collectors configured — state comes from probes only; create a collector key
doctor.collectors.invalid: The collectors map cannot be read — check secrets/collectors.yaml against the contract
doctor.collectors.missing: No collector (probes only): {servers} — create a key and install the helper on the server
doctor.collectors.key: The collector key for {collector} is missing or readable by others — create it again
doctor.collectors.pin: The host key for {collector} is not pinned — run pin and compare the fingerprint
